description: Cut a sprite sheet into frames by grid or by transparent gaps; frame PNGs plus a ZIP. Price: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..
